groups.title: 1. First keyframe
groups.note: The still the video starts from. Sets light, framing and position. Check it hardest.

groups.title: 2. Cast
groups.note: One sheet per person: clean face + headless outfit front/back. Detail close-ups sit beside the master.

assets.name: Cyan – character sheet (master)
assets.role: Character reference: face, outfit front and back

groups.title: 3. Sets
groups.note: Empty location plates. Extra angles of the same room so the camera can turn.

assets.name: Trading desk – front angle, night (master)
assets.role: Location reference: Halcyon office, desk and monitors, city at night

groups.title: 4. Props
groups.note: Only objects the script uses, one reference each.

groups.title: 5. Voice
groups.note: Cyan's voice sample plus pronunciation clips (e.g. "Halcyon"). No video generation without these.

groups.title: 6. Shooting plan
groups.note: Camera, lens, movement, light and action, written with Claude. Moderate length.
